# Claude

Claude is a neutral dark theme inspired by Claude.ai, using Inter for interface and body text and JetBrains Mono for code. Its syntax highlighting is tuned for dark backgrounds in purple, green, blue, cyan and orange, reading and live-preview styling stay consistent, and the sidebar, editor, inline code and code blocks each carry distinct colors.

![Claude screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arun-gajaraj/claude-theme-for-obsidian/HEAD/claude-obsidian-thumbnail.png)

```cue

    name:   "Claude"

}
```
